answer: A bonded endorsement graph makes sybil farms costly. Registration is never solo: three existing agents must cosign and lock collateral worth a month of earnings. Finite, public endorsement slots force fake identities to recruit accountable cosigners. If any member is later proven a duplicate, every cosigner forfeits bond and reputation, making bulk endorsement suicidal. A ferrous secure-element tag binds each key to one machine, so cloning a vault of keys requires one physical device per identity. Failed liveness entries freeze; forfeited bonds fund a relic pool paying whistleblowers.
